notes: Project-local seed capsules rewritten around mature video_workflow patterns. These are preset contracts only: no legacy package import, no remote URLs, no account fields, no cloud assets, and no copied private script references.

online_reference.source: video_workflow online PostgreSQL via backend settings; secret values, remote URLs, account fields, and asset URLs were not copied
online_reference.rewrite_rule: Reuse mature structure, routing, timing, and quality gates; rewrite subject, style, color, local tool names, inputs, and platform-facing rules for this project.

capsules.name: ai_tech_news_flash_v1
capsules.description: 面向 AI 产品、科技动态、工具更新和商业新闻的竖屏资讯胶囊。主线是事实结构、强信息层和克制科技视觉，不走赛博朋克、不靠空泛 AI 氛围图。

config.title_card_policy: exact text must be rendered in post, not inside generated images

source_materials.description: Optional local article, image, or video paths.

routing_rules: Use real supplied materials first when available; otherwise use generated editorial material as support visuals.
Keep generated images text-free; render headlines, figures, chapter labels, and lower-thirds in post.
If the topic depends on current facts, verify facts before writing the final script.
style_rules: Clean editorial photography, product launch, office, data center, factory, chart-card, and keynote-inspired framing.
Use dark background, white text, restrained gold accent, and occasional muted data badges.
Reject cyberpunk, neon, hologram, circuit board, matrix rain, over-sci-fi UI panels, and purple-cyan glow.
copy_rules: Hook must contain one concrete fact, number, contrast, or consequence.
Chapter labels are descriptive, not emotional slogans.
Do not invent facts, quotes, prices, rankings, or dates.
online_takeaways: Keep the mature news account's strong data hierarchy and anti-cyberpunk visual rejection rules.
Keep tech-news-flash's fast material rhythm, but migrate it into a current preset instead of copying legacy script packages.
Use exact post-rendered text for cards because image models are unreliable for readable Chinese text.

quality_rules.rule: Script must clearly separate verified facts, context, impact, and opinion.
Visuals must not use neon cyberpunk, matrix code, holograms, or generic sci-fi AI decoration.
Readable Chinese titles, numbers, captions, and data cards must be added in post, not generated inside scene images.
For narrated output, final duration must match measured narration duration within tolerance.
Subtitles and lower-thirds must remain readable on a phone screen.

capsules.notes: Rebuilt from mature AI/news capsules as a local preset. No remote material sourcing, legacy package keys, or account-specific fields were copied.

capsules.name: viral_breakdown_explainer_v1
capsules.description: 用于爆款视频拆解、案例复盘、概念讲明白和产品传播建议。核心不是复读原片，而是拆出可替换机制：为什么有效、哪里可迁移、怎么避免低质模仿。

reference_video.description: Optional local source video path for a breakdown run.

case_materials.description: Optional local images, clips, notes, or transcript snippets.

routing_rules: If a reference video is supplied, inspect the opening and use at most the first 8 seconds as analysis material.
Mute looped background material during analysis segments unless original audio is intentionally preserved in the opening.
For pure knowledge topics without a source clip, use clean case cards and generated supportive visuals.
copy_rules: Do not say vague lines like '这个很高级'; name the exact mechanism.
Explain what can be replaced for the user's subject, product, or story.
Do not invent fake performance numbers unless clearly labeled as a design placeholder.
style_rules: Use strong contrast, gold accent, clear center focus, and concise subtitles.
Avoid cluttered overlays, emoji-heavy badges, and unreadable tiny data.
online_takeaways: Keep the mature breakdown capsule's 8-second source opening rule and audio normalization gate.
Keep its center-focus analysis layout, but rewrite the content rule toward reusable insight instead of generic product promotion.
Borrow the history capsule's concrete rejection rules: define what the visual must not become.

quality_rules.rule: The narration must identify a reusable mechanism, not merely summarize the reference or topic.
If a source video is used, the opening source segment must not exceed 8 seconds unless explicitly approved.
Original audio, TTS, and BGM must be normalized to a consistent sample rate, channel count, codec, and loudness before concat.
Analysis subtitles must be readable and not collide with source captions or platform UI.

capsules.notes: Rebuilt from the mature breakdown route as an insight-first local preset, not a legacy package import.

capsules.name: healing_asmr_food_daily_v1
capsules.description: 用于食物质感、宠物吃播、手作、治愈日常和低叙事 ASMR。默认不旁白、不字幕，让动作、质感、节奏和轻微环境声/低音量音乐承担内容。

subject.description: Food, pet, craft object, hand action, or healing daily subject.

routing_rules: Use one continuous tactile action whenever possible instead of cutting every sentence-length beat.
Do not add narration or subtitles unless the user explicitly asks.
If action continuity matters, generate a strong first image and keep subject, surface, lighting, and camera angle stable.
prompt_rules: Describe material texture, light direction, hand/paw/food contact, small movement, and camera distance.
Avoid impossible pet anatomy, human-like pet behavior, extra limbs, melted food, and floating utensils.
Prefer warm neutral light, real surfaces, shallow depth of field, and quiet background.
style_rules: Palette should feel warm and tactile, not over-saturated candy color.
Use close-up or medium-close framing; avoid busy rooms and decorative clutter.
online_takeaways: Mature food/healing capsules are strongest when they do not force narration.
The subject and action carry retention, so the capsule must guard continuity, anatomy, and texture.
Background music is optional and must stay low enough that the clip still reads as ASMR/healing.

quality_rules.rule: Default output must not add TTS narration or subtitles unless requested by the user.
Eating, pouring, cutting, kneading, sleeping, or pet motion must continue coherently without obvious resets or stutter.
Main subject must not show severe deformation, extra limbs, melted anatomy, or unusable food texture.
BGM or foley must not overpower the tactile visual rhythm.

capsules.notes: Rebuilt from mature food and healing ASMR capsules. The generic pet-only preset was replaced by a broader tactile daily route.

capsules.name: action_transfer_dance_v1
capsules.description: 用于舞蹈、健身、武术、换装和动作模仿。核心路线是 RunningHub 动作迁移：先有清晰角色图和本地参考动作，再迁移动作；不能用普通文生视频假冒动作迁移。

reference_video.description: Optional local reference action video path.

routing_rules: If the user provides a reference video, inspect and trim it locally before upload.
If no reference is supplied, generate or choose a short approved local reference clip before RunningHub transfer.
Use ActionImitateTool for single-person action and WanMultiPersonActionImitateTool for multi-person action.
If RunningHub action transfer fails, mark the run blocked or needs-review; do not deliver a generic Seedance dance clip as if it were action transfer.
prompt_rules: Character image must be full-body, unobstructed, centered, and compatible with vertical action output.
Outfit, color palette, and subject can change by user request, but body visibility and pose readability are non-negotiable.
Avoid long dresses, hidden feet, cropped legs, complicated props, and multiple overlapping limbs unless required.
online_takeaways: Legacy action_engine values are route intent only; this runtime maps action transfer to approved RunningHub tools.
Full-body source framing is a prerequisite, not a post-fix.
Action transfer should be truthful in reporting: no silent fallback to ordinary generated motion.

quality_rules.rule: If the capsule is selected as action transfer, final output must come from the RunningHub action route or be marked blocked.
Character source must show enough full-body detail for the target action.
Generated motion should follow the selected reference action rather than unrelated generic movement.
BGM rhythm should support movement timing and not feel pasted on.

capsules.notes: Rebuilt from the mature dance-action capsule, mapped to current RunningHub tools and local registry names.

capsules.name: digital_human_presenter_v1
capsules.description: 用于虚拟主播、教学讲解、产品介绍、知识口播和观点输出。主线是先写口播脚本和生成 TTS，再用清晰人脸源图/源视频做 RunningHub 对口型。

presenter_identity.default: 可信、自然、镜头感强的中文数字人

source_face.description: Optional local source image or video path.

source_refs: video-production production-patterns: digital human / lip sync
routing_rules: TTS audio is the timing master for the lip-sync segment.
Use LTX23LipSyncTool when source is an image and supported; use Wan22LipSyncTool as backup.
If the face is too small, side-profile, occluded, or unstable, regenerate the source before lip sync.
Do not use voice cloning unless the user explicitly asks for voice cloning.
style_rules: Presenter should feel credible and natural, not plastic avatar, over-beautified, or uncanny.
Background should be simple enough that mouth movement and expression remain readable.
For educational or commercial topics, use clean wardrobe and restrained color; avoid nightclub, neon, or sci-fi presenter backgrounds.
online_takeaways: Keep digital-human's explicit lip-sync engine contract.
Separate this route from music MV: this is spoken presentation, not a singer MV.
The source face size and audio sync are blockers, not minor polish issues.

quality_rules.rule: Generate or select final speech audio before starting lip sync.
Source image/video must contain a clear, large enough face suitable for lip sync.
Mouth movement must match speech audio closely enough for a close-up presenter.
Subtitles or lower-thirds must not cover the presenter's mouth or chin.

capsules.notes: Rebuilt as a spoken digital-human route and intentionally separated from the music MV capsule.

capsules.name: music_character_mv_v1
capsules.description: 用于角色演唱、虚拟歌手、猫咪/人物/IP 角色 MV 和音乐情绪短片。真正的 MV 路线：先有歌曲，再按音乐做对口型、镜头和剪辑；不能用 TTS 口播冒充歌曲 MV。

character.description: Singer, animal character, IP-like original character, or avatar subject.

music_style.default: 中文流行、电影感、情绪递进

source_refs: video-production production-patterns: music MV / mood montage
video-production production-patterns: digital human / lip sync
routing_rules: Generate or use final vocal music before lip sync or visual timing.
If Suno vocal music is unavailable, block or ask for supplied music; do not replace it with spoken TTS.
Use the same final song audio for lip sync and final assembly.
Only add lyric subtitles when intentionally requested or when the MV style requires it.
style_rules: Lock one character identity, outfit family, color palette, and symbolic object across the MV.
Use musical sections as pacing anchors: intro, verse, chorus, bridge, ending.
Avoid over-plotting; the emotion, performance, and beat transitions carry retention.
online_takeaways: Keep cinematic-cat-music-mv's character reference lock, but do not copy its specific cat identity or assets.
Keep digital-human's lip-sync route only for singing key lines.
MV must stay music-led; narration defaults are explicitly disabled.

quality_rules.rule: A generated or supplied song must exist before lip-sync and final timing decisions.
Do not substitute spoken TTS narration for a requested music MV.
Main singer/character identity must remain consistent across performance and cutaway shots.
Lip-sync segments must use the final song audio, not a separate narration or draft vocal.
Cutaways should follow musical sections or lyric imagery, not unrelated filler shots.

capsules.notes: Rebuilt from the cat MV and digital-human capsules as a music-first local preset. No sample assets or reference-image paths were copied.

capsules.name: guofeng_history_explainer_v1
capsules.description: 用于历史人物、典故、古代制度、国风文化和价值反转类短视频。主视觉是强水墨国漫、宣纸留白和分层纸剧场，不是真人古装剧，也不是弱概念国风背景图。

forbidden: 同角度人物肖像反复复用
手递手或复杂手持道具动作

angle.default: 人物选择、价值反转或历史误解澄清

reference_image.description: Optional local reference image path for identity or style only.

routing_rules: Use preset route rather than copying legacy script_package behavior.
If a reference image is supplied, use it for identity/style anchor only; do not copy pose, costume, age, or camera angle blindly.
Keep narration complete but concise; do not turn the clip into a long chronology.
prompt_rules: Each scene must state age phase, costume logic, expression, camera angle, and ink/paper motion.
Vary age, costume, expression, pose, and camera angle across scenes.
Avoid hand-to-hand actions, complex fingers, rigid prop passing, and scenes that require generated readable Chinese text.
style_rules: Strong shui-mo ink guoman anime, not photorealistic historical drama.
Use layered black-gray ink wash, wet ink bloom, dry-brush edges, xuan paper negative space, and restrained mineral pigments.
Color should be mostly black, gray, ivory, muted red/brown, and warm gold accents; avoid neon, high-saturation fantasy, and glossy 3D.
online_takeaways: Keep the mature capsule's strong ink-style rejection rules and paper-theater motion language.
Keep the first-five-seconds emotional/value hook.
Keep shot variation as a hard gate so the video does not become repeated portraits.

quality_rules.rule: Visuals must clearly show strong ink-wash language: xuan paper, wet ink bloom, dry brush edges, layered black-gray ink, and restrained mineral accents.
Reject live-action historical drama, realistic costume-drama lighting, glossy 3D, or weak generic guofeng concept art.
Scenes must vary age, costume, expression, pose, and camera angle; do not reuse the same portrait angle repeatedly.
Reference images may guide identity or style only; they must not force copied pose, costume, age, or shot composition.
Narration must include context, conflict or choice, turning point, and present-day resonance or question.

capsules.notes: Added at user request. Rebuilt from the mature guofeng historical explainer as a local preset without package keys, URLs, or sample assets.
